typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		DW_Column as string,
		DatabaseType as string,
		SourceFrom as string,
		DBNAME as string,
		Stg_Column as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT 	  DatabaseType =cast(\'Warehouse\' as nvarchar(25)) 	  , SourceFrom= cast(A.SourceFrom as nvarchar(max))      ,Split.a.value(\'.\', \'nVARCHAR(max)\') AS Stg_Column   	,cast( [Table_Schema]+\'.\'+ [Table_Name]+\'.\'+[Column_Name] as nvarchar(max))as DW_Column 	,DBNAME=db_name()  FROM  (SELECT [Table_Schema], [Table_Name],[Column_Name],  SourceFrom         ,CAST (\'<M>\' + REPLACE(SourceFrom, \',\', \'</M><M>\') + \'</M>\' AS XML) AS String             FROM (select [Table_Schema], [Table_Name],[Column_Name], 		  SourceFrom =Replace(SourceFrom,\'\'\'\',\'\')                            from  (SELECT  SCHEMA_NAME(tbl.schema_id) AS [Table_Schema], 							tbl.name AS [Table_Name], 							clmns.name AS [Column_Name], 														cast(CAST(p.value AS SQL_VARIANT) as varchar(max) ) \'SourceFrom\' 					FROM    sys.tables AS tbl 							INNER JOIN sys.all_columns AS clmns ON clmns.OBJECT_ID=tbl.OBJECT_ID 							INNER JOIN sys.extended_properties AS p ON p.major_id=clmns.OBJECT_ID 																	   AND p.minor_id=clmns.column_id 					   					   							) s                                 ) m                 where SourceFrom <> \'Unknown\'                                   ) AS A CROSS APPLY String.nodes (\'/M\') AS Split(a)',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SRCextendedpropertiesfromstg
SRCextendedpropertiesfromstg sink(input(
		TargetMapping as string,
		DatabaseType as string,
		SourceFrom as string,
		DBName as string,
		SourceMapping as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		TargetMapping = DW_Column,
		DatabaseType,
		SourceFrom,
		DBName = DBNAME,
		SourceMapping = Stg_Column)) ~> DSTloadintotempextendedproperties
